prompt: Why should the sample project be downloaded beforehand?
promptZh: 為何應事先下載範例專案？

options.text: Because there will be no electricity.
To avoid slowing the shared wireless connection.
options.zh: 避免拖慢共用無線連線。
options.whyZh: 講者說課程中下載大型檔案可能影響大家速度。

options.text: Because laptops cannot be used after lunch.
options.zh: 因為午餐後不能用筆電。
options.whyZh: 下午仍有練習，沒有禁用筆電。
下載專案與報名是不同事項。

explanationZh: 講者說課程中下載大型檔案可能影響大家速度。
evidence: downloading large files during the session could slow everyone down

vocabulary.note: 有系統地查找與處理問題的過程。
relevant examples 指與參加者問題有關的範例。
